findings.issue: צָפוֹן is a common noun (H6828, feminine singular absolute), left untranslated as the name Tsafón; common nouns stay Spanish.
Definite article in “al lado” and “en el codo” is not in the construct side or the absolute cubit.
“de” before the bare material nouns is grammatical smoothing.

notes: Counts, suffixes, columns, bases, hooks, and bands match the tokens.
